newsitem.title: UK: MED OIL PRODUCTS MIXED -GASOLINE UP ON TIGHT SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: MED OIL PRODUCTS MIXED -GASOLINE UP ON TIGHT SUPPLY.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Tuesday with gasoline a little stronger, gas oil static and high sulphur fuel oil still attracting strong premiums.
Gasoline was a touch firmer with stronger U.S. buying helping to boost NYMEX prices.
Dealers said tight supplies characterised the market with what few cargoes were available able to attract at least +$2.50 over the high cif quotes.
Gas oil continued to slumber in an off-season lull, with heating oil cargoes assessed between $2.50 and $3 over high fob Med quotations basis Italian islands.
Views on cif values varied between $2.50 and $1.50 over high cif quotes basis Genoa. Outright values firmed. September IPE last traded $1 higher at $170.75 a tonne.
Turkey's Tupras bought two cargoes of gas oil totalling up to 60,000 tonnes for August delivery, paying a premium of around $8 a tonne CFR over Italy fob Med quotes.
Traders reported heating oil storage demand into Greece and 0.2 percent diesel demand into Syria.
High sulphur fuel oil continued to be strong with premiums for bunker spec in the high cif Med plus $3/$4 range, with crude values improving a little.
In the absence of material in the Med, a refiner was still looking for a bunker spec cargo in northern Europe to take to Las Palmas, traders said.

One percent was quiet but the supply/demand picture was said to be balanced. Traders said that the levels were largely unchanged around the $105/$107 mark for cif cargoes but others put them $1 lower.
No new tenders were heard on low sulphur with traders saying Lebanon and Israel were covered for the time being.
